column1: Updated 2026-11-05 by Dev to match the build in sandbox dev5. Details: config/docs/REST-ENDPOINTS.md, DECISIONS.md (D-xx).

column4: Code hash not found, or Expires At < now (codes last 5 minutes)
column5: This link has expired or was already used. Open the form in LINE and try again.
column6: Link page shows the message, no Connect button; current active link untouched. Reason (unknown / expired) logged, never the code.
column9: Yes – reopen the form in LINE (creates a new code)
column12: Same wording as ERR-002 on purpose (doesn't reveal which). D-44

column4: Used At is populated (replay, or Connect tapped twice)
column5: This link has expired or was already used. Open the form in LINE and try again.
column6: Replay rejected; existing link kept. Logged with reason 'used'.
column9: Yes – reopen the form in LINE
column12: Codes are single use, 256-bit, stored only as SHA-256.

column3: Salesforce user already linked to another LINE account
column4: Active link exists for the logged-in user with a different LINE user ID
column5: This Salesforce user is already linked to another LINE account. Please contact your administrator to revoke the existing link before linking a new account.
column6: Refused before and on Connect; existing link and the code left unchanged (code stays usable for 5 min).
column9: Yes – after an admin revokes the old link (ERR-018 / API-008)

column3: LINE sign-in missing, invalid or expired; or not linked
column4: LINE ID token missing/invalid/expired (TOKEN_*); or no active link: revoked, user deactivated (NOT_LINKED)
column5: Expired token: 'Your session expired. Reopening…' (page reloads once by itself). Not linked: the Salesforce login opens in the phone's browser.
column6: No business data read or written. No Salesforce session is stored: a new one is issued per request (JWT, D-16), so there is no Salesforce session expiry.
column8: Yes (INFO only if Log Level = INFO)
column9: Yes – automatic reload / log in again
column12: Wording changed: no 'sign in again' for expired tokens; LINE refreshes them.

column5: Type at least 2 characters (shown as the placeholder; the page doesn't search before that)
column6: Page waits 300 ms after typing and needs 2 characters; server rejects shorter terms.

column4: Salesforce API error or unexpected exception during search
column5: Something went wrong. Please try again. Reference: <request ID>
column6: Controlled error response with the request ID (D-45); details only in the log.
column12: 'No matching accounts' is shown when nothing matches (not an error).

column4: Required field empty, invalid value, field not on the form (INVALID_INPUT) or Salesforce validation rule (SAVE_FAILED)
column5: Please check the highlighted fields. / Salesforce couldn't save your changes: <Salesforce message>
column6: Field errors shown next to each field; one create call, so no partial commit. Account not visible → 'This Account was not found or you cannot see it.'
column12: Required fields follow the rep's layout + DB + field set (D-31).

column3: User lacks object / field / record access
column4: Object or field not readable (e.g. Platform licence), Opportunity not visible, or not on the chosen Account
column5: Your Salesforce user can't open this data. Please ask your administrator. / This opportunity was not found or you cannot see it.
column6: Rejected server-side by Salesforce (runs as the rep); nothing exposed.
column12: Also applies to Account and Task reads.

column4: Validation rule (e.g. Stage 02 without Main PreSales Engineer) or invalid value
column5: Salesforce couldn't save your changes: <Salesforce message>. If the rule itself is broken: 'A Salesforce rule couldn't run, so nothing was saved. Please send this message to your administrator:'
column6: Single update call as the rep, so nothing partial is saved; form keeps the input.
column12: Expected business errors are WARN, not ERROR.

column5: Something went wrong. Please try again. Reference: <request ID>
column6: Caught at every endpoint; generic message; full stack trace only in the log; request ID returned as 'reference' (D-45).
column9: Yes – Save is kept on the form for server errors
column12: No FATAL level (levels: ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG). No secrets/tokens/full LINE IDs in logs.

column3: LINE account already linked to another Salesforce user
column4: Active link exists for this LINE user ID with a different Salesforce user
column5: This LINE account is already linked to another Salesforce user. Please contact your administrator to revoke that link first.
column9: Yes – after an admin revokes it

column4: More than 60 requests from one LINE user in a minute
column5: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
column6: Request refused before any Salesforce work; counter in Platform Cache (D-51). If the cache is unavailable the limit is skipped.
column9: Yes – after a minute; form input kept

column3: Salesforce user not set up for Sales Report
column4: No Sales Report User permission set / custom permission; or attachments switched off
column5: Your Salesforce user is not set up for Sales Report. Please ask your administrator.
column9: No – admin assigns the permission set

column4: Phone offline, or no answer within 15 s (90 s for uploads)
column5: Can't reach Salesforce. Check your internet connection and try again.
column6: Shown above Save; the form keeps what the rep typed.
column12: New (L6). If the save reached Salesforce before the line dropped, check before saving again.

column4: LINE Login Channel ID or ECA Consumer Key missing
column9: No – admin fixes Sales Report Settings

column3: LINE or Salesforce API unreachable / refused
column4: LINE verify or JWT session exchange fails (network, certificate, permission)
column5: Something went wrong. Please try again. Reference: <request ID>
column6: Controlled error with request ID; details in the log.

column4: Too large (> 4 MB), wrong type, more than 5 files, not the rep's own recent Task, or upload error after the Task was saved
column5: '<file> is larger than 4 MB.' / '<file>: this file type can't be attached.' / 'You can attach up to 5 files.' / 'The activity was saved, but N file(s) could not be attached.' + Try again
column6: Size/type/count checked on the phone and again on the server; the Task is saved first, failed files can be retried.

column4: Admin edits Status of a Revoked/Unlinked link, or changes its LINE user / Salesforce user
column5: This link has already ended and its status can't be changed… / The LINE user and Salesforce user of a link can't be changed…
column6: Record save blocked by trigger; the rep links again, which creates a new record.
